{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Dragon| type2=Flying| trainername=Winona| pokemonname=Altaria| jtrainername=ナギ| jpokemonname=チルタリス| tmtrainername=Nagi| tmpokemonname=Tyltalis| image=[[File:Winona Altaria Adventures.png|230px]] | caption=Winona's Altaria | gender=Female{{tt|*|Confirmed in Pokémon Adventures}}| ability={{a|Natural Cure}}{{tt|*|Confirmed in Pokémon Adventures}}| epnum=PS211| epname= Hanging Around With Slaking III| prevonum=334| noevo=incap | current=[[Party|With Winona]]| java1=[[Chinami Nishimura]] }} '''Winona's Altaria''' (Japanese: '''ナギのチルタリス''' ''Nagi's Tyltalis'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Winona]] in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== Altaria first appeared in ''[[PS211|Hanging Around With Slaking III]]'', where [[Flannery]] and Winona rode her in search of [[Norman]]. After finding Norman, Altaria departed with the three Gym Leaders. She was later seen with Winona while waiting for the Hoenn Gym Leaders (save for Flannery who already made the call and [[Tate and Liza]] who are unable to make it). [[File:Chic vs Winona Altaria.png|thumb|left|200px|Altaria battling Chic]] In ''[[PS226|I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!]]'', after {{adv|Sapphire}} arrived in [[Fortree City]], Altaria battled [[Chic]]. Following Chic's [[Evolution]] into a Blaziken, Altaria was hit by the newly evolved {{pkmn|category|Blaze Pokémon}}'s {{m|Blaze Kick}}. The impact gave Altaria a chance to use {{m|Refresh}} while hiding in the sky. Altaria came down with a {{m|Sky Attack}} and defeated Chic. After the battle, Altaria trained Chic to get stronger and Winona pointed out to Sapphire about her attacks. Altaria flew away with Winona when Winona got a call from someone. [[PS235|Later]], Altaria flew around in Hoenn with Winona and Sapphire on her {{p|Tropius}}, [[Troppy]], witnessing a {{a|drought}} and {{a|Drizzle|heavy rain}}. They stopped by {{rt|123|Hoenn}}. Winona and Altaria separated from Sapphire and Troppy, and then flew to where the [[Aqua Admin (Trainer class)#In the manga|SSS]] was. Altaria entered by firing {{m|Dragon Breath}} at Shelly and Matt and then fought them alongside her {{p|Skarmory}}. When [[Wattson]] was defeated, Altaria attempted to dive after Wattson to save him but [[Matt]] prevented Altaria from listening to Winona by having his {{p|Sharpedo}} use {{m|Taunt}}. Altaria flew to the [[Pokémon Association]]'s headquarters and dropped off Flannery and Wattson to rest up from their injuries while both Altaria and her Trainer flew to [[Sootopolis City]]. Winona picked up Sapphire and went on Altaria to evacuate the area since {{p|Absol}}'s {{m|Magic Coat}} was wearing off. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== In [[PS616]], Altaria assisted in stopping the [[Grand Meteor Delta]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== Altaria has been used by Winona often, more than any other of her Pokémon. As such, Altaria was happy to work alongside Winona. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|dragon|flying|Winona Altaria {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=DragonBreath|1=Sky Attack|2=Refresh|3=Dragon Dance|4=Flamethrower}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Dragon Breath|1=Sky Attack|2=Refresh|3=Dragon Dance|4=Flamethrower}}}} {{anmov|dragon|Dragon Breath|PS226|I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|flying|Sky Attack|PS226|I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!}} {{anmov|normal|Refresh|PS226|I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!}} {{anmov|dragon|Dragon Dance|PS226|I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|PS245|Bravo, Vibrava|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ==In animation== [[File:Winona Altaria.png|thumb|250px|Altaria in {{aniseries|AG}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== Altaria's sole appearance was in ''[[AG085|Sky High Gym Battle!]]''. When {{Ash}} had his [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} with Winona, the Gym Leader sent out Altaria as her first Pokémon against him with Ash countering with {{AP|Grovyle}}. The {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon started the match with {{m|Peck}} and clashed with Grovyle's {{m|Bullet Seed}}. Altaria tried using Peck again, but Grovyle avoided the hit by jumping onto a totem pole in the battlefield. Altaria switched to {{m|Dragon Breath}} and successfully landed a hit onto Grovyle. It attempted to use Dragon Breath again, but Grovyle dodged it and countered with Bullet Seed, though it dealt very little damage to Altaria. Altaria used Dragon Breath for a third time, but Grovyle jumped onto Altaria and attacked with {{m|Leaf Blade}}, defeating it. ====Personality and characteristics==== Very little is known about Altaria's personality, as it was only seen battling {{AP|Grovyle}}. However, during battle, it has great strength, as shown when Ash and Grovyle reacted to it and were struggling at first. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|dragon|flying|Winona Altaria {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Peck|1=Dragon Breath}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Peck|1=Dragon Breath}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Peck|AG085|Sky High Gym Battle!}} {{anmov|Dragon|Dragon Breath|AG085|Sky High Gym Battle!}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ===GOTCHA!=== Winona's Altaria briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}}''' |gen=3 |ndex=0334 |pokemon=Altaria |gender=female |level=33 |type1=Dragon|type2=Flying |ability=Natural Cure |move1=Earthquake|move1type=Ground |move2=DragonBreath|move2type=Dragon |move3=Dragon Dance|move3type=Dragon |move4=Aerial Ace|move4type=Flying}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Emerald}}
